experience.title: Front Office Manager
bullets: Lead a front office, reservations and concierge team of 14 in a 90-room resort.
Manage rates and availability on the booking engine and online travel platforms, lifting occupancy from 58% to 74%.
Plan staff schedules around peak seasons and train new hires on service standards.
Handle escalated guest complaints and follow up after departure.
Coordinate weddings and conferences with the events and food teams.

experience.title: Front Office Supervisor
bullets: Supervised front desk shifts and handled arrivals and departures for tour groups.
Planned tours and transfers for guests with local operators.

headline: Resort Front Office Manager
summary: Front office manager with eleven years in hotels and resorts in Zamboanga. I run front desk, reservations and concierge teams, manage rates and online channels, and make sure arrivals and departures go smoothly even at full occupancy. I train staff, handle difficult guests personally and coordinate events and tours.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Hotel and Restaurant Management
